Power 
 Stations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the minor maintenance procedures P1, to 
be performed 
from three to six years 
as indicated by Y3:6 in the title block
The first draft initiated by eng. 
Kamel Tawfeq Gad Al Sayed, tested at 13 April 2003 by eng. Badry
Atia Rofaiel &
Kamel Tawfeq Gad Al Sayed, accepted by General 
Director eng. Moustaf Abd El Nazeer, and approved by Sector Head of
 Assuit thermal Power station at UEEPCo.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
category.
Wear your safety helmet, shoes .... etc
Tools and Equipment
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes .... etc,
Test 
 Instrument: TM1600 SA - 0020 R05DV000, MA61 SA0038R07 CV000
Portable earth's support stick.
Voltmeter, Test leads,
SF6 gas detector
Grease "L" 
 and grease "G"
Vacuum cleaner.
Work to be Carried Out
Carryout the three months 
 maintenance procedures as in MPIS document no. CB-157-r0a
Rust Protection
Remove patches of rust and treat with a rust 
 inhibitor
Make sure there is no oil 
 leakage from dashpot, change dashpot if required and ensure that the new 
 dashpot is filled with oil "S" .
Clean the rust spots and apply new inhibitor with a brush or 
 spray the recommended rust inhibitor is grease "G" or Tectyl 506 (ABB art No. 
 1241 0011-108) N.B. Tecfyl 506 is a waxy protectine skin ......... wheels
Lubricate the sliding surfaces on the dashpot using Grease "G"
Lubrications
Check that the circuit breaker in open position and the closing spring is 
 off - loaded.
Grease the latches on the operating mechanism 
 using Grease "L"
Check that the circuit breaker in open position and the closing spring is 
 off - loaded.
Clean the operating mechanism using vacuum cleaner.
Grease the latches on the operating mechanism 
 using Grease "L"
Grease the shafts in the latch mechanisms 
 using Grease "L"
Check that there is no loose bolts or nuts
Operating Test ( Closing & 
 opening time measurements)
Check that there is no gas leakage using SF6 gas detector.
Check that there is no gas leakage using SF6 gas detector.

Thermovision Measurements
Carry out the thermovision 
 measurements at full load taken into 
 consideration as well as large variations in the load 3-4 hrs before 
 measurement
